Library extends weekend hours

Starting next month, the Millbrook Public Library will stay open until eight o'clock on Saturdays and will open on Sunday afternoons for the first time in its history, the library board announced.

The change follows a survey in which more than two thirds of respondents said weekend hours were the hardest for them to visit. The board said it would review attendance after six months before deciding whether to keep the new schedule.

Funding for the extra hours comes from a state grant that also pays for two new part-time staff members and a small expansion of the children's room.
